text:
```artifact
Decision Table for Requirement VCMCL03-1: Edit/Update Chemist/Labs Screen
Conditions:
- Query Type: (Chemist/Lab Id, Chemist/Lab Name, Address, Contact Details)
- Existence Check: (Chemist/Lab Id exists?)
Actions:
- Display Details: (Yes → Display; No → Exception)
- Modify Details: (Yes → Allow; No → Exception)
- Delete Details: (Yes → Allow; No → Exception)

Decision Table for Requirement VCMCL03-2: Exception for Non-Existent Chemist/Lab
Conditions:
- Existence Check: (Chemist/Lab Id exists?)
Actions:
- Display Message: (No → "Chemist or Lab does not exist"; Yes → None)

Decision Table for Requirement VCMCL03-3: Delete Chemist/Lab with Open Prescription Requests
Conditions:
- Open Requests Check: (Open Prescription Requests exist?)
Actions:
- Delete Chemist/Lab: (Yes → Exception "Chemist or Lab has open Prescription Requests - cannot delete"; No → Delete)

Decision Table for Requirement VCMSYM01: Administrators Menu to Maintain Symptoms
Conditions:
- Operation Type: (Add Symptom Code, Edit/Update Symptom Codes)
Actions:
- Add Symptom: (Add → Prompt for Symptom Code, Description; Edit → Display Symptom Code, Description)
- Update Symptom: (Yes → Allow; No → Exception)

Decision Table for Requirement VCMSYM02: Add Symptom Code Screen
Conditions:
- Input Validation: (Symptom Code unique?)
Actions:
- Add Symptom: (Yes → Store Symptom Code, Description; No → Exception)

Decision Table for Requirement VCMSYM03: Edit/Update Symptom Screen
Conditions:
- Existence Check: (Symptom Code exists?)
Actions:
- Display Details: (Yes → Display; No → Exception)
- Modify Details: (Yes → Allow; No → Exception)
- Delete Details: (Yes → Allow; No → Exception)

Decision Table for Requirement VCMPA01: Update Patient Profile and Raise Consultation/Appointment Request
Conditions:
- Profile Update: (Patient Id exists?)
Actions:
- Update Profile: (Yes → Update; No → Exception)
- Raise Request: (Yes → Allow; No → Exception)

Decision Table for Requirement VCDPA02: Patient Registration Screen
Conditions:
- New Registration: (Username/Password valid?)
Actions:
- Capture Details: (Yes → Capture Patient Id, Name, Age, Sex, Address, Contact; No → Exception)
```
